name: bookdrop
description: Bookdrop monorepo orchestrator: delegates commands to each service in services/* and to web/

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix services/library-core && npm ci --prefix services/identity-service && npm ci --prefix services/notifications-service && npm ci --prefix services/gateway && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.prisma:generate: npm run prisma:generate --prefix services/library-core && npm run prisma:generate --prefix services/identity-service && npm run prisma:generate --prefix services/notifications-service
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix services/library-core && npm run build --prefix services/identity-service && npm run build --prefix services/notifications-service && npm run build --prefix services/gateway && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix services/library-core && npm test --prefix services/identity-service && npm test --prefix services/notifications-service && npm test --prefix services/gateway
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix services/library-core && npm run lint --prefix web
